color.note: Dracula on black. Dark is the brand and the default; light exists for the CV toggle and print. Names follow the theme keys in melchard's dracula.yaml; role aliases sit at the end.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background on every site. Near-black, not Dracula's grey; every site already uses it.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Raised opaque surface: command palettes, footer bars, highscore panels. Bordered with line, never shadowed except as an overlay.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Translucent panel on bg for the CV sections (GlassCard). Opaque in light.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card borders, input-row dividers, table rules, the toggle track. Muted at 25 percent in dark.

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: The 24px background grid behind the CV page, drawn with two linear-gradients at space-6 pitch.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Body text and typed characters, on bg, card and glass. 18:1 on bg in dark.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hints, metadata, line numbers, correct characters, the legal footer. Reads on bg, card and glass. Dark is 4.1:1 on bg, below the 4.5:1 floor, and stays as is by decision: use it for labels and hints in mono at 12px or larger, never for body copy someone must read. Light is 4.9:1 on white.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Dracula cyan. Links, prompts, the timer, active palette rows, hover text, bullet markers, the section outline. As text on bg, card and glass: 14:1 dark, 5.2:1 light.

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: The name (h1), the export action, the timeline dots, the dark side of the theme toggle. As text on bg and glass: 9:1 dark, 4.6:1 light.

tokens.name: purple
tokens.usage: Section headings (h2) on the CV, kinds and categories in the apps. 8:1 dark, 5.8:1 light on bg.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Organisation names on the CV, done marks, add actions. 15:1 on bg in dark. Light is 3.8:1 on white: headings and marks only, not small text.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Warnings, undo, in-progress editors. Dracula's orange; it replaces the amber #f59e0b feelz used for warnings and chat mode. Light is 3.2:1 on white: 19px bold or larger, or a mark, never small text.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Danger, incorrect characters, the close glyph, and the block caret in the terminal and typing line. Dracula's red; it replaces #ef4444 (feelz) and #c0392b (witchblades). 6.7:1 dark, 4.8:1 light on bg.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Row fill for hover and keyboard focus in palettes and lists: accent at 7 percent over card.

tokens.name: ghost
tokens.usage: Ghost text: the autocomplete suggestion after the cursor in the terminal input. Decorative by design; not meant to pass a contrast floor.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Full-screen backdrop behind a command palette or highscore panel.

tokens.name: scrim-blur
tokens.usage: Backdrop of the finish overlay inside the typing area, paired with blur-sm.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Anchor text. Alias of accent, so links follow the theme's accent.

tokens.name: caret
tokens.usage: The block caret and cursor bar. Alias of red.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Role alias: something completed or available.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Role alias: needs attention, undo, unsaved.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Role alias: destructive, wrong, closing.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Role alias: a category or kind.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Role alias: the one thing on the page the eye should land on first.

families.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: The apps and terminal sites: feelz, witchblades, and the Go apps that consume this system. System monospace, no web font.

styles.name: mono-line
styles.sample: i just wanna die in my sleep
styles.usage: The single typing line in witchblades. 22px under 600px wide, 18px under 400px.

styles.name: mono-stat
styles.usage: The result line in the finish overlay; the numbers in accent at weight 700.

styles.name: mono-input
styles.usage: The terminal input line on feelz. 16px so iOS does not zoom the field.

styles.name: mono-timer
styles.usage: The countdown timer, centred in the top bar, in accent.

styles.name: mono-body
styles.usage: Default app text, palette inputs and prompts.

styles.name: mono-small
styles.usage: Song name, time options, palette rows, table cells.

styles.name: mono-caption
styles.usage: Terminal history lines, the legend, export links.

styles.name: mono-label
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels in help output and the mode indicator. Set in muted.

styles.name: mono-kbd
styles.usage: Key caps inside Kbd. 9px under 600px wide.

groups.name: Sans
groups.note: The CV at melchard.org. Satoshi is named in the theme but no font file is in the repository, so it renders in the system sans until one is added.

styles.name: sans-display
styles.usage: The name at the top of the CV, in pink. clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 42px).

styles.name: sans-role
styles.usage: The role line under the name, in accent.

styles.name: sans-body
styles.sample: Built the data platform end to end.

styles.name: sans-h2
styles.usage: Uppercase section headings in purple, 32px above and 12px below.

styles.name: sans-small
styles.usage: Contact rows in muted, organisation names in green.

styles.name: sans-meta
styles.usage: Dates, degrees, and the Export action (weight 600).

styles.name: sans-item
styles.usage: Command palette rows and toggle labels (0.8rem, weight 500).

styles.name: sans-sec
styles.usage: Uppercase group labels inside the command palette, in muted.

spacing.note: Pixel steps as the sites use them; the 24px step is also the background grid pitch.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a history line or table row.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps in help grids, bullet margins, contact rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps between kbd and label, time options, palette icon and text.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding inside palette rows and footer bars; legend gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: The page side gutter (width is calc(100% - 32px)); palette row horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Grid gap on the CV, top bar padding, and the background grid pitch.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Padding inside a glass panel.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space above a section heading.

size.note: Fixed measures the layouts are built on.

tokens.name: measure-app
tokens.usage: Max width of an app column: min(720px, calc(100% - 32px)). Health uses 640px.

tokens.name: measure-palette
tokens.usage: Max width of a command palette or highscore panel.

tokens.name: measure-cv
tokens.usage: Max width of the CV page.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Footer bars and the search bar.

tokens.name: tap-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height of the terminal input on touch screens.

tokens.name: cursor-width
tokens.usage: The typing-line cursor bar; the terminal uses a block caret.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: The cursor bar.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Kbd caps and the sub-active highlight.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Palettes, highscore panels, week editors, video frames.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Footer bars, search bar, the command palette on the CV.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The keyboard-navigation outline around an active CV section.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Glass panels on the CV; 22px under 760px wide.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The toggle track.

tokens.name: radius-circle
tokens.usage: Toggle knob, timeline dots, round icon buttons, the QR image.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Only on floating panels over a scrim. Everything else is bordered with line, not shadowed.

tokens.name: blur-sm
tokens.usage: The finish overlay, with scrim-blur.

tokens.name: blur-md
tokens.usage: The video overlay on the CV.
